segs.utf8: Hello friends, today we will talk about how machine learning works.
First, let us understand what a neural network is.
It is made up of many small neurons.
Each neuron takes some numbers and gives out a new number.
We call these numbers weights.
To teach the network we need a lot of data.
When the network makes a mistake, we measure its cost.
Then we change the weights a little at a time with gradient descent.
This process is repeated thousands of times.
[Music]
Slowly the network learns to give the right answers.
But learning too much carries the risk of overfitting.
So we keep separate test data.
I hope you liked this video.
In the next video we will learn about convolution.
